Selected work

Five projects. One question: does this actually help someone?

A collection of products, prototypes, and experiments. One is a live independent venture, another is an open-source desktop tool, two grew out of enterprise requirements, and one is an ongoing research intelligence experiment. These five projects reflect the problems I've tried to understand, the trade-offs I've made, and the software I've learned to build.
